payload.body:
The [contributors wall](../blob/main/contributors.md) has six numbered slots reserved as guaranteed first-PR opportunities. **Slot 6 is open** — this is the last numbered slot. After this fills, additions go in alphabetically without needing to claim a slot.

## What to do

Replace this line in [`contributors.md`](../blob/main/contributors.md):

```
6. *Slot 6 — open. Claim via the corresponding issue.*
```

with:

```
6. [Your Name](https://github.com/your-username) — first contribution: [PR title](pr-url-once-you-open-it)
```

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Slot 6's placeholder line is replaced with your real entry.
- [ ] The format matches the existing entry on slot 1: `- [Name](github-profile-url) — first contribution: [PR title](pr-url)`.
- [ ] No other slots are modified.
- [ ] The PR includes `Closes #` referencing this issue.

## Estimated time

~10 minutes.

## Want to work on this?

**Comment below to claim it before working on it.** Once you claim, it's yours. New to opening a PR? See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
